error_text:
TypeError: data.map is not a function
    at list (server.js:426:270)
context: Rendering a list in client.js throws on .map().
root_cause: config is not an array here — it is an object, null, or a single item.
fix: Normalize before mapping: `Array.isArray(items) ? items : [items]`, and fix the producer to always send an array.
title: TypeError: data.map is not a function
